author: guthrie@vast.ai
subject: Use CLN-3661 display names in notification directories; move low-balance note out of list

excerpts.text: Open [Account Settings](https://cloud.vast.ai/account/) and go to **Notification Settings**. Host events appear only when you provide machines on Vast.ai.
| **Maintenance window confirmed** | Confirms a maintenance window you scheduled, as it will be communicated to renters. |
For a description of every host event, see the [full list of host notifications](#all-host-notifications) at the end of this page.

later_local_edit: 5088d76b89856185f3ab15a628e4152ff140ab26 on August 26 changed only Notification Type Keys endpoint routing; it did not introduce Host visibility, Host section, full directory, or maintenance-event descriptions.
limits: Original product guide predates this review and local host-doc rewrite. It supports documented semantics, not a current delivered notification or authenticated settings run.
